propositions: Codex currently lacks a project-scoped Serena MCP server entry in .codex/config.toml despite project reliance on Serena/Pyright for semantic navigation
Serena 1.6.2.dev0 at commit c7dbe3bd1198cf451bf7aa8fdeeab88571fa3a6e supports --context codex and --project-from-cwd flags required for worktree-aware CLI agent integration

A STDIO MCP server entry must be added to .codex/config.toml pinning the verified Serena upstream commit with startup_timeout_sec=120 and required unset to enable project-scoped discovery without blocking Codex on startup failure
The configuration must be project-scoped so all contributors automatically gain semantic navigation after trusting the repository without modifying individual global configs
Validation requires TOML structural correctness, codex mcp list discovery of the enabled serena entry with pinned argv, and MCP initialize/list-tools smoke testing within the worktree
The project-scoped server must not be injected outside the trusted rebar project directory per negative control validation
